questionSet.label: US 24352 - Safety Knowledge
questionSet.title: Demonstrate and apply knowledge of safe working practices in the construction of a BCATS project

questions.text:
Match the appropriate eye protection PPE to the hazard.

PPE Type: Polycarbonate face shields
questions.hint: Think about fast-moving chips/particles and the need to protect more than just the eyes.
options: Low velocity flying particles and objects

questions.text:
Match the appropriate eye protection PPE to the hazard.

PPE Type: Hood and helmet (completely sealing the face)
questions.hint: If it seals, what kind of hazard is it trying to keep OUT of your breathing/eye area?
options: Low velocity flying particles and objects

questions.text:
Match the appropriate eye protection PPE to the hazard.

PPE Type: Wide vision goggles
questions.hint: Think about higher-energy chips than normal workshop tasks (more impact protection than basic glasses).
options: Low velocity flying particles and objects

questions.text:
Match the appropriate eye protection PPE to the hazard.

PPE Type: Safety glasses
questions.hint: General workshop protection for typical jobs with small chips.
